newsitem.title: POLAND: POLAND'S PLOCK REFINERY LIMITS PRICE INCREASE.
newsitem.headline: POLAND'S PLOCK REFINERY LIMITS PRICE INCREASE.

text.p: Poland's biggest oil refinery Petrochemia Plock SA will increase prices of its petrol by less than earlier announced because of favourable conditions on world crude and petrol markets, Plock said on Saturday.

Plock, which this week announced it was increasing from June 22 petrol prices by 0.03 zlotys per litre and reducing the price of diesel fuel by 0.02 zlotys, said in a statement it would partially offset the rise with discounts for retailers.

"Because of the recent stabilisation of crude prices and a steady fall in petrol prices Petrochemia Plock SA did not introduce in full the earlier planned increase in petrol prices by offering...distributors a rebate," it said.
Plock said it would offer a 0.02 zloty discount on the price of unleaded fuel and 0.01 zloty discount for leaded fuel.
Without the rebates the recommended retail prices were to rise to 1.71 zlotys per litre for the 94-octane leaded petrol and to 1.67 zlotys for the unleaded 95-octane petrol.
The price of diesel fuel is due to fall to 1.35 zlotys per litre. -- Warsaw Newsroom +48 22 653 9700
